author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
Today on the Official Marvel Podcast, we’re joined by Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Ben Kingsley to discuss Marvel Television’s latest series, Wonder Man! We’ll also recap the Department of Damage Control’s transformation from the MCU’s cleanup crew to their latest role investigating Simon Williams in Wonder Man. Plus, DK editor David Fentiman and author Liz Marsham drop by to share the latest on Marvel Studios Cross-Sections, a brand new book offering a unique look inside the locations, vehicles, and more from the MCU.
